source_snapshot.procedure: Check the BMC version in the BIOS Server Management page, in-band and out-of-band with ipmitool mc info, in the BMC web UI, and with a Redfish GET to /redfish/v1/Managers/bmc.
source_snapshot.criteria: All BMC versions should be correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: Return only the out-of-band ipmitool Firmware Revision line for user confirmation.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the same approved BMC firmware revision is reported correctly through every source-required management view.
original_test_intent.target: The identified SUT's BMC through BIOS Server Management, host in-band IPMI, network out-of-band IPMI, BMC web UI, and Redfish.
original_test_intent.scope: Cross-interface consistency and comparison with an approved BMC firmware baseline; no firmware update, reset, power control, or log clearing is part of this case.
original_test_intent.operation: Collect the BMC version from each required path, protect credentials, normalize only owner-approved formatting differences, and compare all observations with the expected version and one another.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One observation per required interface for the same SUT/BMC instance; source timing is 10 attended and 20 machine minutes.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required interface reports the approved BMC version, with no unexplained mismatch or missing observation.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC identity, approved expected version, timestamped redacted output or screen evidence from all five required views, normalization rule, comparison result, and unexpected-log delta.
ambiguities: The source does not provide the expected BMC version or permitted representation differences.
The BIOS and web-UI acquisition method and whether BIOS entry requires a reboot are not specified.
The Manager resource identifier `bmc`, TLS trust method, credentials, and IPMI cipher support are platform-specific.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly made IPMI/Redfish queries read-only, protected secrets, required an expected baseline and handled path disagreement. However, it made BIOS and BMC-web observations merely supplemental, which reduces the source-required cross-interface scope.

applicable_history.decision: Read-only collection is not BLOCKED merely because packages, targets, credentials, or expected values must be supplied.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The IPMI and Redfish portion is safely automatable, but the source explicitly requires BIOS and BMC-web observations. Until approved browser/KVM automation is available, this is a hybrid collection workflow rather than a fully automated one; the missing expected version does not prevent collection of actual values.

available_now: The version-check purpose and five observation paths are explicit; IPMI Get Device ID and Redfish Manager FirmwareVersion are read-only.
Actual IPMI/Redfish values and endpoint identity can be collected before the expected-version baseline is provided, but no PASS may be declared.
missing_inputs: Approved BMC version and allowed formatting/auxiliary-revision mapping
BMC endpoint, authorized secret delivery, TLS trust policy, supported IPMI transport/cipher, and actual Redfish Manager URI
Approved method for BIOS Server Management and BMC-web evidence, including reboot/window approval if BIOS entry is required
Approved package versions or existing availability of ipmitool, curl, and a JSON parser
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/firmware owner supplies the expected version and mapping; the lab/BMC administrator supplies target, access, TLS, UI/KVM, and maintenance authorization.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Discover the Redfish Managers collection and collect Manager identity/FirmwareVersion with an authenticated GET using protected secrets
Run in-band and authorized out-of-band `ipmitool mc info`, redact secrets, and record actual revisions without asserting PASS
prohibited_until_closed: Do not use literal source credentials, expose secrets in a URL/process list/evidence, assume `/Managers/bmc`, force cipher suite 17, disable TLS verification without an approved lab exception, clear logs, reboot into BIOS, or change BMC state without authorization
Do not omit BIOS/web evidence or declare PASS from the ipmitool line alone
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner supplies the baseline and version mapping; every required path is collected against the same verified BMC, and any reboot/UI activity plus credential/TLS method is approved.

revision_candidate.purpose: Confirm that the approved BMC firmware revision is reported consistently by BIOS Server Management, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, the BMC web UI, and Redfish.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The identified server and BMC with authorized host, management-network, browser/KVM, and Redfish access. Manager URI, certificate policy, IPMI cipher, and UI paths are platform-specific.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One verified SUT/BMC instance across all five source-required interfaces; do not substitute a different management controller or reduce the check to one CLI path.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Expected BMC version, permitted display normalization, BMC identity/address, protected credentials, TLS trust policy, Redfish Manager URI or discovery access, supported IPMI settings, UI/KVM method, and BIOS-access approval/window.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect in-band and out-of-band `ipmitool mc info`; discover the target under `/redfish/v1/Managers` and read its `FirmwareVersion`; collect the BMC-web and BIOS Server Management version displays through approved browser/KVM or manual evidence. Compare every value with the baseline and each other.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Verified SUT/BMC identity, authorized least-privilege read access, approved tools and secret mechanism, trusted or explicitly excepted lab TLS path, expected-version baseline, and approved BIOS/UI access method.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Expected version and normalization rule; redacted timestamped IPMI outputs; Redfish Manager URI, identity, and FirmwareVersion; BIOS and web-UI screen evidence; cross-path comparison; and before/after unexpected-log delta without clearing history.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Platform firmware recipe or release baseline supplied by the firmware owner. DMTF Manager FirmwareVersion defines the Redfish value but does not supply the platform's expected revision.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only queries only. Never embed or log credentials, contact an unverified endpoint, clear logs, reset/update the BMC, change power state, or reboot for BIOS evidence without approval.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner confirmation of the expected version and mapping is required for PASS/FAIL; authorization is required for credentials and any reboot/interactive BIOS access.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: IPMI/Redfish collection and comparison are automatable. BIOS and BMC-web observations remain manual unless an approved KVM/browser automation path captures equivalent evidence.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on endpoint/authentication/certificate mismatch, preserve redacted evidence, exit UI/KVM without saving changes, and return the host to its prior boot state if an approved BIOS reboot was used.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unverified target, exposed credentials, failed authentication, unapproved TLS exception/cipher/reboot, missing required path, version disagreement without an approved mapping, or inability to preserve redacted evidence.

identified_defects: DeepSeek reduces five required observation paths to one out-of-band IPMI line.
The source contains literal credentials and disables TLS verification, which must not be copied into execution or evidence.
The source assumes a vendor-specific Redfish Manager identifier and IPMI cipher suite.
V2 incorrectly treats BIOS and web-UI evidence as optional supplemental evidence.
reason_for_change: Preserve the original cross-interface check while separating automatable inventory collection from UI/BIOS access and owner-dependent acceptance.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046
new_technical_evidence.supports: Manager FirmwareVersion is a read-only string and Manager resources use an implementation-specific ManagerId.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The SUT's Manager URI and representation remain platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: ipmitool MC implementation
new_technical_evidence.supports: The Get Device ID response is rendered with Firmware Revision, manufacturer, product, IPMI version, and optional auxiliary firmware fields.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Platform-specific correspondence between IPMI fields, web/BIOS display, and release baseline requires owner mapping.

removed_ambiguities: All five source-required views are mandatory unless the testcase owner revises scope.
Actual versions may be collected before the expected baseline, but collection alone cannot yield PASS.
Manager ID, TLS exception, cipher suite, and formatting are explicit platform inputs rather than universal constants.
resolved_blockers: Missing tools, credentials, endpoint, and expected baseline are provisionable readiness items, not evidence that version collection is technically impossible.
remaining_blockers: Final execution/decision waits for expected-version mapping, authorized access, and the approved BIOS/web evidence method.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 reverses V2's scope reduction by retaining BIOS and BMC-web observations, reclassifies the resulting hybrid workflow, and replaces unsafe hard-coded endpoint/credential/TLS assumptions with explicit platform inputs while preserving safe automated IPMI/Redfish collection.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator retained all five mandatory BMC firmware observation paths, their distinct execution locations, expected-version mapping, identity proof, and read-only boundary.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires BMC version observations from BIOS, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, BMC web, and Redfish.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 made BIOS and web checks supplemental; V3 preserves them and treats the case as hybrid until UI/KVM automation exists.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Use read-only queries, protected secrets, discovered/verified endpoints, and approved BIOS access; never copy literal credentials or infer PASS without the baseline.
